mission: Far below the broken Glasswell, where the floodwater has gone still, a cold white-blue spark flickers once in the dark.
why_now: Everyone has left Iresh. The water has settled. What the dark holds now is what was left behind.
conflict: The final image belongs to the Glasswell's dark and what persists inside it — a cold white-blue spark that is not dead and not unchanged.
setting: Iresh, deep beneath the broken Glasswell — the lowest chamber of the collapsed cavern system, far below the surface. Absolute cold. Absolute dark. The floodwater has gone still. Mineral dust settled across every surface. No light reaches this depth. Then, at the deepest point, a single cold white-blue spark flickers once and holds. The dark remembers it.

stakes.personal: The spark is all that is left of Aevyn — not a character POV, not an interior, just the fact that something survived the dark and the cold.
stakes.interpersonal: No relationship is active here. The image is solitary: the dark, the water, the spark.
stakes.external: The spark flickers once and holds. The dark remembers it. What comes next for Aevyn is outside this book.

sensory_details: Absolute cold. Absolute dark. Floodwater that has gone still and flat, not turbulent — settled into itself after the violence of the collapse. Mineral dust on every surface. No sound except the distant drip of water from somewhere above. The pale mineral walls are invisible in the dark. Then, at the deepest point of the lowest chamber, a cold white-blue spark — not light, not warmth, just a specific color of persistence.

turning_point_detail.trigger: The floodwater goes still in the deepest chamber — all motion spent, the collapse finished, the surface world gone.
turning_point_detail.shift: A cold white-blue spark flickers once in the absolute dark. It holds.
turning_point_detail.cost: Nothing is resolved. Aevyn survived, changed, alone, in the dark below the place his certainty broke.

emotional_arc.start: Dark, cold, still — the aftermath of destruction.

key_beats.beat_description: Absolute dark fills the lowest Glasswell chamber — floodwater gone still, mineral dust settled across every surface, no sound from above.
key_beats.state_change: The violence of the collapse is spent; what remains is cold, settled, and complete.
key_beats.pov_reaction: the quality of the dark — not empty, accumulated

key_beats.beat_description: A cold white-blue spark flickers once at the deepest point of the chamber.
key_beats.state_change: Something in the dark has not ended — not light, not warmth, just a specific color of persistence.
key_beats.pov_reaction: the color before the meaning of it; the flicker registered by no one

key_beats.state_change: Aevyn survived, changed, alone — the dark remembers it.
key_beats.pov_reaction: the stillness after the flicker; no witness, only the fact
